scientific_integrity: The theorem is analytically proved with an explicit two-branch spoke derivative optimization, commuting semigroup factorization and sharp star norm. All finite computational checks are supporting tests, not infinite proofs.
scientific_limitations: Unnormalized counting-measure Laplacian; wheel rim conductance 1, common positive spoke conductance, graph edge lengths fixed at 1.
Exact fixed-parameter all-time norm formula is not claimed; the sharp analytic envelope is optimized across spoke conductances.
No normalized-generator, nonuniform conductance or general Halin-graph result is claimed.
Priority/independent validation has not been established.
title: Weighted wheel heat flow: a contractivity boundary and a sharp star-limit amplification envelope
